reason: Hypothesis A is more specific and testable: it explicitly defines the intervention (vapor-deposited Cu coating + CPF), the processing conditions (energy density 25–35 J/cm², cooling rate 10⁶–10⁷ K/s), a measurable predicted outcome (≥20% void reduction, improved thermal conductivity and mechanical durability) against a named baseline, and a clear falsification rule. Hypothesis B is vaguer, lacks quantitative thresholds, and does not commit to a single, decisive experiment.
